main_text.p: Unde passim illæ formulæ in S. li-teris exstant, Nos per Christum habere adi-tum seu accessum ad Deigratiam, adeoque per Christum ad Deum adduct. Rom. 5, 2. & 11. Ephes. 2.18. 1.Tim.2.5. 1.Pet.1.21. cap. 3.18. Heb. 7. 25. Mediator hic noster in statu humiliationis Deo Patri obedies factus in vitâ simul & morte, catenus justitiam & salutem nobis promeruit. Et quia nullum magis arduum opus nostrâ causâ suscepit, quàm cum mortem obivit, & sanguinem suum pro nobis effudit, idcirco passim sanguini & morti CHRISTI condonatio, justificatio & reconciliatio adscribitur. Gra-tia itaq; Dei & Meritum JESU CHRISTI non debent inter se opponi, cum istud potius illi subordinandū fit, quippe quod ex mero Dei beneplacito profluxit. Alterum medium intra nos si-tum est, nempe fides in JESUM CHRISTUM, qua misericordiam illam Dei in JESU CHRISTO exhibitam, adeoq; Christi meritis comparatam, ample-ctimur.

page.notes: The mark "320" at the right edge is faint and appears to be handwriting or show-through, so it is left out. The "O" before "SED" at the foot is a large printed letter; it is read as the start of the catchword "O SED", but its status is doubtful. The "Deigratiam" join and the "subordinandū" macron are uncertain readings. Long s is rendered as s throughout.
